<<NOTES ON WHITEWASHING A CELLAR WALL>>

WHITEWASHING A CELLAR WALL IS A COMMON PRACTICE TO PREVENT MOLD AND DUST FROM BUILDUP. IT IS DONE BY APPLYING A THIN LAYER OF WHITEWASH OVER THE WALLS AND FLOOR. THIS PROCESS HELPED TO MAKE THE SPACE MORE CLEAN AND FRESH. THE WHITEWASH IS MADE FROM LIME AND WATER, AND IT IS APPLIED WITH A SPOUT OR A TROWEL. IT IS IMPORTANT TO MAKE SURE THE WHITEWASH IS EVENLY DISTRIBUTED TO COVER ALL SURFACES. THIS STEP IS ESSENTIAL FOR KEEPING THE CELLAR SAFE AND CLEAN FOR THE FUTURE.
